message.content: I start by sorting the laundry bags, then I fold the clean towels and put them away. There's also a part where I help move the linen carts. I try to keep a routine because that seems to help me stay focused. I don't hear the voice as much when I'm busy with work. It's pretty quiet there, so maybe that's why it doesn't bother me as much. I just do my job and try not to think about it too much.
